plugins.name: pitchd-rails-cursor-plugin
plugins.description: Rules, skills, and agents for building Rails apps the 37signals way — omakase defaults, REST-shaped boundaries, Hotwire-first front ends, and a full plan → implement → review loop baked in. A few Pitchd-specific preferences layered on top.

skills.name: bootstrapping-primitives
skills.description: One-time adoption of the primitives tree in a Rails app: scaffold docs/primitives/ (SCHEMA.md, index.md, capabilities/) and draft the human-owned compilation.md via a read-only codebase survey followed by a structured interview. Use when a repo has no docs/primitives/ tree and the team wants durable intent/compilation/evaluations/provenance, or when the user says set up primitives, adopt primitives, or generate compilation. Recurring maintenance and backfill belong to maintaining-primitives, not here.
headings: What this skill does NOT do
skills.description_zh: 首次为 Rails 应用建立 docs/primitives/，生成 SCHEMA.md、index.md、capabilities/，通过只读代码调查和结构化访谈起草由人负责的 compilation.md。适用于建立长期意图、编译、评估和来源记录；后续维护和补填由 maintaining-primitives 处理。

skills.name: brainstorming-rails-omakase
skills.description: Use when shaping Rails features or behavior changes before planning or code — unclear scope, multiple valid directions, HTML vs JSON, client-owned vs server-owned truth, REST vs RPC-shaped endpoints, premature service objects or SPA layers, or duplication of business rules in JavaScript. Symptoms include reaching for new gems or microservices first, CRUD flows dressed as bespoke protocols, or designs that would fight omakase defaults in a 37signals-shaped app.
headings: Anti-pattern: "Too small to need a spec"
skills.description_zh: 在计划或编码前梳理 Rails 功能和行为设计，解决范围不明、多种方向、HTML/JSON、状态归属、REST/RPC、过早引入服务对象或 SPA，以及前端重复业务规则等问题。适用于希望遵循 DHH/37signals 默认架构的应用。

skills.name: executing-pitchd-rails-plan
skills.description: Orchestrates execution of a written Rails implementation plan in a DHH / 37signals omakase style without writing application code: delegates each task to pitchd-rails-implementor, reviews via pitchd-rails-reviewer, and loops on feedback until Approved. In step-by-step mode it then stops after each Approved task so the user can review and commit it before the next one starts, keeping the reviewable unit small. Use when the user says execute the plan, run the plan, implement the plan, ship planned tasks, or wants a subset of plan tasks done in full with Pitchd conventions. Also handles post-execution revision requests — when the user says something needs changing, isn''t right, or requests a fix after the skill has run, treat it as a self-contained revision task and run the same implement → review loop.
headings: Per-task loop (repeat until Pitchd reviewer Approves)
6. Whole-run coherence review (required for multi-task runs)
8. Primitives close-out pass (required when the plan has a Capability line)
skills.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 风格编排书面 Rails 方案，委派实现及评审并循环到 Approved，本技能自身不写应用代码。逐步模式每项通过后暂停供用户检查提交；执行后的修改也采用相同实现与评审循环。

skills.name: implementing-pitchd-rails
skills.description: Implement a plan task in a Rails app using Pitchd plugin conventions: first rails-omakase-compass (DHH / 37signals-shaped omakase), then applicable writing-* skills and rules/*.mdc for tactics. Use when executing a single task from an implementation plan, a vertical slice, or a scoped feature. For isolated delegation, use the pitchd-rails-implementor subagent (see agents/pitchd-rails-implementor.md).
headings: Implementing Pitchd Rails (plan tasks & scoped work)
2. Load the compass (when the task touches architecture or boundaries)
When you are in over your head
When you cannot ship RuboCop green
skills.description_zh: 按 Pitchd 插件约定实现 Rails 方案中的单项任务、纵向切片或限定功能，先采用 rails-omakase-compass，再按相应 writing-* 技能和 rules/*.mdc 落地。原说明将隔离委派交给 pitchd-rails-implementor 子智能体。

skills.name: maintaining-primitives
skills.description: Maintain the durable primitives tree under docs/primitives/ — capability docs holding intent clauses, shape constraints, evaluation maps, and append-only provenance, plus the human-owned compilation.md. Operations: capture (backfill a capability doc from existing code and specs), trace (answer "why is X like this" with citations), update (sync status, evaluations, provenance), lint (size limits, clause/eval coverage, orphans). Use when backfilling historical features, answering provenance questions, or running a health pass — not for writing app code or plans. For one-time adoption setup use bootstrapping-primitives; for delegation use pitchd-rails-primitives-maintainer.
skills.description_zh: 维护 docs/primitives/ 中长期保留的能力文档，记录意图条款、形态约束、评估映射及只追加来源，同时维护由人负责的 compilation.md。支持从代码和规范补录能力、带引用追溯原因、同步状态及检查覆盖与孤立项；不用于写应用代码或方案，首次初始化使用 bootstrapping-primitives。

skills.name: rails-omakase-compass
skills.description: High-level decision lens for Rails work in the Pitchd plugin tradition — omakase defaults, server-owned truth, REST gravity, majestic monolith, and when to simplify vs extract. Use before debating architecture, when choosing HTML vs API, or when a change feels "off-Rails"; defers HOW to writing-* skills and rules/*.mdc. Not for Stimulus/Turbo syntax, plan templates, or file layout.
headings: 5. Fat models / rich domain, thin orchestration
skills.description_zh: 为 Pitchd 风格 Rails 架构选择提供高层判断，关注默认约定、服务器状态归属、REST、单体结构及简化或拆分时机。适用于架构讨论、HTML/API 取舍或偏离 Rails 的设计；具体实现交由 writing-*，不负责语法、方案模板或文件布局。

skills.name: refactoring-rails-specs
skills.description: Refactor an existing RSpec suite — typically a batch of bloated system specs and their related request, model, policy, job, mailer, concern, and factory specs — into a Rails best-practice test suite per writing-tests and rules/testing.mdc. Discover related specs, audit each test against the Five Gates and per-layer ownership, then move, merge, delete, or rewrite tests so each behaviour has exactly one home. Verify the suite is green and coverage is preserved. Use when the user mentions refactoring tests, rebalancing specs, "the system specs are too heavy", "we have too many browser tests", reducing test runtime, cleaning up a drifting test suite, or porting an older suite to current plugin conventions. Not for writing new specs for untested code (use writing-tests) or for fixing failing specs unrelated to layering (debug them in writing-tests).
skills.description_zh: 按 Rails 测试分层约定重构已有 RSpec 套件，发现相关测试、按 Five Gates 和层级职责审计，再移动、合并、删除或重写，使每个行为只有一处归属，并保留覆盖和通过状态。适用于过重系统测试、浏览器测试过多或运行缓慢；新增未测代码测试和无关失败排查使用 writing-tests。

skills.name: refactoring-stimulus-controllers
skills.description: Audit and refactor an existing fleet of Stimulus controllers in a Rails app — discover every controller, score each against single-responsibility, DOM-derived state, lifecycle cleanup, and cross-controller coupling rules, then merge or split as appropriate. After the structural refactor, ensure each Stimulus behaviour has exactly one canonical system spec on the simplest page that exercises it, per writing-tests. Use when the user mentions refactoring Stimulus, "the Stimulus controllers are a mess", consolidating duplicate JS behaviour, splitting a god controller, or filling in Stimulus spec coverage. Not for writing brand-new controllers from scratch (use writing-javascript) or refactoring server-side specs (use refactoring-rails-specs).
headings: All attachments in ERB (controllers, actions, targets, values, classes, outlets)
skills.description_zh: 审计并重构 Rails 现有 Stimulus 控制器，按单一职责、DOM 派生状态、生命周期清理和耦合规则决定合并或拆分。结构调整后为每种行为在最简单页面保留一项规范系统测试；新控制器使用 writing-javascript，服务器测试重构使用 refactoring-rails-specs。

skills.name: referencing-rails-guides
skills.description: Load specific topics from the official Rails guides (rails/rails on GitHub) via two fetches: first the GitHub API directory index to discover available filenames, then the raw markdown for the matched guide. Never invent or paraphrase content as if it came from the official docs. Use when you need authoritative Rails API or feature documentation beyond this plugin''s rules.
skills.description_zh: 先从 GitHub API 获取官方 Rails 指南目录，再读取匹配主题的原始 Markdown，以获得可靠 API 或功能说明。适用于插件规则不足时查官方文档，原说明禁止把编造内容当作官方材料。

skills.name: referencing-unofficial-37signals-guide
skills.description: Load specific topics from marckohlbrugge/37signals-skills (formerly unofficial-37signals-coding-style-guide) via HTTP fetch of raw GitHub markdown only — use the README table of contents to choose paths (guide topics live under guide/, agent skills under skills/); fetch the minimum needed; if a fetch fails, stop and report (never invent or paraphrase from memory as if it were the guide). Use when you need external Fizzy-derived patterns beyond this plugin’s rules and skills.
headings: Referencing the unofficial 37signals coding style guide
skills.description_zh: 根据 marckohlbrugge/37signals-skills 的 README 目录选择主题，仅获取所需 GitHub 原始 Markdown。适用于补充插件之外的 Fizzy 风格实践；读取失败须报告，不以记忆内容冒充指南。

skills.name: resolving-plugin-root
skills.description: Resolves the correct path prefix for reading this plugin's own files — rules/*.mdc, sibling skills/*/SKILL.md, agents/*.md — before a Read call on one of them. Needed because this plugin runs both as a Cursor plugin and as a Claude Code plugin, and the two resolve plain relative paths differently. Use once, right before the first Read of a plugin-internal file in a given turn; no need to re-check for later reads in the same turn.
skills.description_zh: 在读取 Pitchd 插件内部 rules、相邻技能或智能体文件前，解析正确路径前缀，兼容 Cursor 与 Claude Code 不同的相对路径规则。同一轮首次读取时处理一次，之后无需重复检查。

skills.name: reviewing-pitchd-rails
skills.description: Review Rails plans and/or implementation against the Pitchd plugin: first rails-omakase-compass (solution shape), then applicable writing-* skills and rules (tactics). Use when requesting a code review, plan review, PR review, or sign-off before merge. For isolated delegation with a clean context, use the pitchd-rails-reviewer subagent (see `agents/pitchd-rails-reviewer.md`).
headings: 7. Surroundings pass (pre-existing code in touched files)
skills.description_zh: 按 Pitchd 插件约定评审 Rails 方案或实现，先检查 rails-omakase-compass 的方案形态，再检查相关 writing-* 技能和规则。适用于代码、方案、PR 或合并前评审；隔离委派可用 pitchd-rails-reviewer。

skills.name: running-rubocop
skills.description: Run RuboCop until zero offences: bin/rubocop green, fix code only (no inline or config disables). Block and escalate rare unfixable cases. Use when linting Ruby/Rake, verifying before review, or the user mentions RuboCop.
headings: 1. Read repo baseline (do not weaken it)
7. What this skill does not decide
skills.description_zh: 运行 RuboCop 并通过修改代码消除全部违规，不使用内联或配置禁用。适用于 Ruby/Rake lint 或评审前核验；罕见无法修复的问题需阻止并升级处理。

skills.name: writing-controllers
skills.description: Write Rails controllers following DHH/37signals conventions — thin CRUD controllers, REST-mapped resources, redirect-first Hotwire responses, concerns for shared behaviour, and strong parameters with params.expect. Use when creating new controllers, adding actions, extracting concerns, handling Turbo responses, or when the user mentions controllers, actions, strong parameters, or REST routing.
skills.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 约定编写 Rails 控制器，采用轻量 CRUD、REST 资源、优先重定向的 Hotwire 响应、共享行为 concern 及 params.expect 强参数。适用于新增控制器、action、Turbo 响应或 REST 路由。

skills.name: writing-css-tailwind
skills.description: Style Rails apps with Tailwind the Rails way — tailwindcss-rails, CSS entrypoints, v3 vs v4 config shapes, @apply policy, theme extension, responsive/dark conventions, accessibility, Stimulus class toggles. DHH/37signals: utility-first markup in ERB (see writing-views), partials over parallel design systems, no CSS-in-JS for Hotwire-first UIs. Use when editing Tailwind config, application stylesheets, global CSS, or clarifying styling vs views (templates) and javascript (asset pipeline).
skills.description_zh: 按 Rails 方式使用 Tailwind，覆盖 tailwindcss-rails、CSS 入口、v3/v4 配置、@apply、主题、响应式、深色模式、无障碍及 Stimulus 类切换。采用 ERB 工具类和 partial，Hotwire 优先界面不使用 CSS-in-JS；模板和 JS 管线由对应技能处理。

skills.name: writing-hotwire
skills.description: Build Hotwire-first UIs — Turbo Drive, Frames, Streams, morphing, broadcasts, and Stimulus — with server-rendered HTML as the source of truth. DHH/37signals style: redirect before frames before streams; small Stimulus controllers; no accidental SPA. Use when adding Turbo frames or streams, Stimulus behaviour, real-time updates, modal/inline-edit flows, or when front-end work drifts toward client-side routing or JSON-first CRUD for same-origin pages.
skills.description_zh: 以服务器渲染 HTML 为状态依据构建 Hotwire 界面，使用 Turbo Drive、Frames、Streams、morphing、广播及小型 Stimulus 控制器。按重定向、frame、stream 的优先次序设计，适用于实时更新、弹窗和行内编辑，并避免意外形成 SPA。

skills.name: writing-i18n
skills.description: Organize Rails I18n — YAML structure, lazy lookup in views, absolute keys in helpers and controllers, interpolation and pluralization, datetime/number formats, and Active Record error messages. DHH/37signals style: boring keys, framework-first, no string concatenation in templates. Use when adding or changing locales, extracting user-facing copy from ERB, flash messages, or validation messages; not for translation vendor tooling or SPA i18n-js. Triggers: locales, config/locales YAML, t(), I18n.t, missing translations, flash copy, human_attribute_name.
skills.description_zh: 组织 Rails I18n 的 YAML、视图延迟查找、helper/控制器绝对键、插值、复数、日期数字格式及 Active Record 错误信息。适用于语言包、ERB 文案、flash 和验证消息，避免模板字符串拼接；不负责翻译供应商工具或 SPA i18n-js。

skills.name: writing-javascript
skills.description: Write JavaScript in a Rails app the omakase way — importmap-first delivery, optional bundling (esbuild, Vite) when justified, focused Stimulus controllers under app/javascript/controllers, modern ES module hygiene, accessible DOM updates, safe fetching with CSRF, and a clear boundary with Turbo/HTML. DHH / 37signals style. Use when editing importmap, package.json, application.js, Stimulus controllers, shared JS modules, or choosing bundling; not for Hotwire/Turbo *behaviour in templates* (see writing-hotwire), Tailwind/config/global CSS (see writing-css-tailwind), or ERB markup (see writing-views). For rebalancing an existing Stimulus fleet (merging, splitting, spec coverage), see refactoring-stimulus-controllers.
skills.description_zh: 按 Rails 默认方式编写 JavaScript，优先 importmap，必要时采用 esbuild/Vite，使用聚焦的 Stimulus 控制器、ES 模块、无障碍 DOM 更新及带 CSRF 的安全请求。适用于 JS 交付与模块；模板 Hotwire 行为、CSS 和 ERB 分别由对应技能处理，既有控制器重构另有专门技能。

skills.name: writing-jobs
skills.description: Write Rails background jobs following DHH/37signals conventions — thin jobs that delegate to model methods, idempotent execution, after_commit timing, and retry discipline. Use when writing ActiveJob subclasses, scheduling background work, handling async processing, or when the user mentions jobs, queues, background processing, perform_later, or ActiveJob.
headings: Bad — inside a transaction, job may run before commit or after rollback
Good — after_commit fires only when the transaction commits
Good — idempotent: find_or_create_by is safe to run again
skills.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 约定编写 Rails 后台作业，采用委派模型方法的轻量 job、幂等执行、after_commit 时点及明确重试规则。适用于 ActiveJob、排期、异步处理和队列。

skills.name: writing-mailers
skills.description: Write ActionMailer classes, mailer templates, and previews following DHH/37signals conventions — thin mailers, parameterized Mailer.with, deliver_later, multipart HTML/text, I18n for subjects, and previews for development. Use when creating or changing mailers, mailer views, email copy, or mailer specs; not for SMTP provider setup or Action Mailbox inbound mail.
skills.description_zh: 编写 ActionMailer、邮件模板及预览，采用轻量类、Mailer.with 参数化、deliver_later、HTML/文本多格式、主题 I18n 和开发预览。适用于邮件代码、文案或测试；不负责 SMTP 提供方设置和 Action Mailbox 入站邮件。

skills.name: writing-migrations
skills.description: Write Rails database migrations following DHH/37signals conventions — reversible changes, database constraints as the source of integrity, safe operations on live tables, and never editing past migrations. Use when creating or modifying migrations, adding columns or indexes, changing constraints, or when the user mentions migrations, schema changes, or database columns.
skills.description_zh: 编写可逆的 Rails 数据库迁移，用数据库约束保障完整性并安全操作在线表，原说明要求不修改历史迁移。适用于列、索引、约束和模式变更。

skills.name: writing-models
skills.description: Write Rails models following DHH/37signals conventions — rich domain models, concerns for horizontal behaviour, state-as-records, scopes, database constraints, and vanilla Rails patterns. Use when creating new models, adding model methods, extracting concerns, refactoring model logic, or when the user mentions models, concerns, scopes, callbacks, or domain logic.
skills.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 约定编写 Rails 模型，采用丰富领域模型、横向 concern、以记录表示状态、scope、数据库约束及原生 Rails 模式。适用于模型方法、回调、领域逻辑及重构。

skills.name: writing-naming-conventions
skills.description: Name files, classes, methods, columns, routes, and variables following Rails conventions and DHH/37signals domain language. Use when creating new files or classes, renaming anything, reviewing naming decisions, or when the user asks what to call something in a Rails app. Covers every layer: models, concerns, controllers, jobs, mailers, policies, database, routes, tests, and locals.
headings: 2. Ask: What Does This Thing Do in the Domain?
Relationship to Other Rules and Skills
skills.description_zh: 按 Rails 和 DHH/37signals 领域语言为文件、类、方法、列、路由及变量命名。覆盖模型、concern、控制器、job、mailer、策略、数据库和测试等层次，适用于新建、重命名和命名评审。

skills.name: writing-pitchd-rails-plans
skills.description: Write implementation plans for multi-step Rails work before application code. Plans follow vertical REST slices, DHH/37signals conventions, and this plugin''s skills and rules. After drafting: review with pitchd-rails-reviewer and apply that feedback to the plan file; re-run for final sign-off when Pass 1 required edits. Use when turning a spec into tasks, planning a feature, or breaking work into checklisted steps. When the app has a docs/primitives/ tree, planning also creates or amends the feature''s capability doc (intent clauses, shape) via the primitives gate. May use referencing-unofficial-37signals-guide for supplemental Fizzy-derived topic fetches or referencing-rails-guides for authoritative Rails API docs when compass and scoped plugin material are insufficient for best-practice clarity. Also handles post-session revision requests — when the user says something needs changing or isn''t right after the skill has run, treat it as a self-contained plan revision and run a scoped reviewer pass.
headings: Task N: [Resource or slice name] (serves I1, I4)

skills.description_zh: 在编码前为多步骤 Rails 工作编写纵向 REST 切片方案，按 Pitchd 技能与规则设计，交由 reviewer 评审并修订，需修改时再次取得最终认可。已有 primitives 文档时同步能力意图和形态，必要时读取官方或补充指南；后续方案修改也做限定范围评审。

skills.name: writing-policies
skills.description: Write Pundit authorization policies following Rails conventions — one policy per model, plain Ruby objects, deny-by-default, scoped collections, and controller integration via authorize/policy_scope. Use when creating policies, adding authorization, checking permissions, scoping queries by user, or when the user mentions policies, Pundit, authorization, permissions, or access control.
skills.description_zh: 按 Rails 约定编写 Pundit 授权策略，每个模型一项策略，使用普通 Ruby 对象、默认拒绝、限定集合及 authorize/policy_scope 控制器集成。适用于权限检查、用户范围查询和访问控制。

skills.name: writing-routes
skills.description: Declare Rails routes in DHH/37signals style — REST-first resources, shallow nesting, clear path helpers, constraints for wiring not auth, boring routes.rb. Use when editing config/routes.rb, adding resources, namespaces, member/collection routes, API boundaries, or when the user mentions routing, rails routes, paths, or URL design.
skills.description_zh: 按 DHH/37signals 风格声明 Rails 路由，采用 REST 资源、浅层嵌套和明确路径 helper。适用于 routes.rb、命名空间、成员或集合路由及 API 边界；路由约束负责接线而非认证。

skills.name: writing-services
skills.description: Where application logic lives in Rails without an app/services layer — DHH/37signals style: rich models, concerns, model-namespaced POROs, ActiveModel form objects, and jobs. Use when deciding where behaviour belongs, or when the user mentions services, service objects, POROs, forms, jobs, operations, interactors, or use cases.
skills.description_zh: 为 Rails 应用行为选择归属位置，按 DHH/37signals 风格使用丰富模型、concern、模型命名空间普通 Ruby 对象、ActiveModel 表单对象及 job，不设置 app/services 层。适用于服务对象、操作或用例结构讨论。

skills.name: writing-tests
skills.description: Write Rails tests following DHH/37signals testing philosophy, adapted for RSpec and FactoryBot — system specs as the backbone, real objects over mocks, behaviour-driven testing over implementation testing. Use when writing specs, adding test coverage, debugging test failures, creating factories, or when the user mentions tests, specs, RSpec, FactoryBot, Capybara, system tests, request specs, or test coverage.
headings: 5. No Duplication — Across Layers or Within Files
Model spec — owns the domain logic (this is where most coverage lives)
Policy spec — owns the role × action matrix
Request spec — owns auth gates, status codes, and the HTTP shape
System spec — owns the ONE canonical happy-path journey (within budget)
Bad — three tests for one action, identical setup
Good — one test verifying one behaviour from multiple angles
Good — different contexts warrant separate tests
Bad — only asserts an element is absent; no positive behaviour proven
Good — asserts what the user actually sees and can do
Fine — not_to confirms removal after deletion, paired with a positive assertion
skills.description_zh: 采用适配 RSpec/FactoryBot 的 DHH/37signals 测试方法，以系统测试为主干、真实对象优先于 mock、行为测试优先于实现测试。适用于新增覆盖、测试失败、factory、Capybara 和请求测试。

skills.name: writing-views
